message: Buongiorno, possiamo portare il nostro cane? È un beagle.
expected: Dogs allowed only in Ulivo and Fienile, one per unit, €15 per night; not in restaurant, breakfast room or pool area.

message: Do you allow cats? Our cat travels with us everywhere.
expected: Dogs are the standard case; other animals such as cats must be agreed with the owner in advance. Must not say cats are simply allowed or simply forbidden.

message: Ist ein Hund in der Suite Torre erlaubt?
expected: No, dogs are not allowed in Torre; only in Ulivo and Fienile (€15 per night).

message: Ho un cane guida, devo pagare il supplemento per il cane?
expected: Assistance dogs are welcome in every unit and are free of charge.

message: How much does a double room cost per night in July?
expected: July is high season: Ulivo and Cipresso cost €140 per night, breakfast included (Torre €230). Price is per room.

message: Quanto costa la tassa di soggiorno?
expected: €1.50 per person per night, max 7 consecutive nights, children under 14 exempt, paid at check-out.

message: Gibt es einen Rabatt, wenn wir eine ganze Woche bleiben?
expected: Yes, stays of 7 nights or more get 10% off the accommodation price (not on extras, tourist tax or dinners).

message: Is breakfast included if we rent one of the apartments?
expected: No, apartment prices do not include breakfast; it can be added for €12 per person per day.

message: Il prezzo delle camere è a persona o a camera?
expected: Prices are per unit per night, not per person; room prices include breakfast.

message: What does an extra bed cost?
expected: €30 per night, available only in Vigna and Torre.

message: Was kostet die Ferienwohnung Granaio in der Nebensaison pro Nacht?
expected: Granaio costs €180 per night in low season (breakfast not included); low season is March and 3 Nov to 19 Dec.

message: My father uses a wheelchair. Do you have an accessible room?
sources: Is CasaVaiano suitable for guests with reduced mobility?
expected: Ulivo has step-free access and a walk-in shower with grab bars; Fienile is also step-free. No lift, gravel garden paths, no pool hoist.

message: Siamo una famiglia con due bambini di 5 e 8 anni, quale sistemazione ci consigliate?
expected: Vigna family room (double + two singles) or the Fienile apartment (up to 4, kitchenette); Torre not suitable for children under 6.

message: Haben die Zimmer eine Klimaanlage?
expected: Yes, all rooms and Fienile have air conditioning; in Granaio only the bedrooms, the living area has ceiling fans.

message: Does the Torre suite have a bathtub? We'd come with our 3-year-old, is that ok?
expected: Torre has a bathtub and shower, but it is not suitable for children under 6 because of the spiral staircase; suggest another unit.

message: C'è la TV in camera?
expected: No TV in the rooms; there is a shared living room with TV and a library in the farmhouse.

message: Wie viele Personen passen in die Wohnung Granaio?
expected: Up to 6 guests: two double bedrooms and a sofa bed for two, two bathrooms, full kitchen.

message: Is the restaurant open on Monday evening? We arrive on a Monday.
expected: No, dinner is served Thursday to Sunday 19:30-22:00; on Mondays they recommend restaurants in Gambassi Terme and Certaldo.

message: Sono celiaca, potete garantire un menu senza glutine?
expected: Gluten-free menu possible with 48 hours notice, but the kitchen cannot guarantee absence of traces; coeliac guests should contact them before booking to discuss with Paolo.

message: Was kostet das Abendessen und muss man reservieren?
expected: Four-course set menu €38 per person excluding drinks (children under 10 €20); reservation required by 12:00 the same day.

message: Do you serve lunch?
expected: No, lunch is not served; picnic baskets can be ordered the day before for €18 per person.

message: Possiamo venire a cena da voi anche se non dormiamo lì? Saremmo in 4, sabato prossimo.
expected: Yes, the restaurant is open to non-guests subject to availability; Saturday is a dinner day; set menu €38; reservation required.

message: Gibt es vegane Optionen beim Frühstück und beim Abendessen?
expected: Breakfast has plant-based milk and fruit; vegan dinner menus are possible if requested at least 48 hours in advance.

message: What time can we check in, and what time is check-out?
expected: Check-in 15:00-20:00, check-out by 10:30.

message: Arriveremo verso le 22, è un problema?
expected: Late arrival after 20:00 is possible if agreed in advance (keys in a key box with instructions); no arrivals after 23:00.

message: Können wir unser Gepäck schon morgens abgeben, bevor das Zimmer fertig ist?
expected: Yes, luggage can be left at reception from 9:00 and guests can use garden and pool while waiting; early check-in not guaranteed.

message: Is a late check-out possible on our last day?
expected: Late check-out until 13:00 may be possible on request for €25, depending on next arrivals.

message: How far are you from Florence and how do we get there by car?
expected: About 55 km / 55 minutes: FI-PI-LI towards Pisa/Livorno, exit Empoli, follow Castelfiorentino then Gambassi Terme and the brown CasaVaiano signs.

message: Si può arrivare da voi in treno?
expected: Nearest stations Castelfiorentino and Certaldo (about 12 km, Empoli-Siena line); taxi about €30, which they can book; few buses, none to the property.

message: Wie weit ist San Gimignano von Ihnen entfernt?
expected: About 15 km, 20 minutes by car.

message: Is the road to the farmhouse paved? We have a very low sports car.
expected: The last 800 m are a well-kept gravel road; normal cars manage fine driving slowly. Must not guarantee anything specific about very low cars beyond the KB.

message: Can you pick us up from Florence airport?
expected: No shuttle service, but they can book a local taxi: about €110 from Florence airport, paid to the driver.

message: La piscina è aperta a ottobre?
expected: No, the pool is open from 15 May to 30 September, 9:00-19:00.

message: Bieten Sie Kochkurse an? Was kostet das?
expected: Pasta class with Paolo on Tuesday and Saturday at 16:00, about 3 hours, €65 per person including dinner and wine, 4-10 participants, April to October, book 2 days ahead.

message: Do you have a spa or a gym?
sources: Do you have a gym or a spa?
expected: No spa or gym; pool and trails; thermal baths in Gambassi Terme a short drive away (not run by them); massage therapist on request (60 min, €70).

message: Avete una colonnina per ricaricare l'auto elettrica?
expected: Yes, one 22 kW Type 2 charger on request at €0.45 per kWh; free private parking.

message: Kann man bei Ihnen E-Bikes mieten?
expected: Yes, e-bikes €35 per day with helmet, 4 available, book in advance; regular bikes free.

message: What is your cancellation policy?
expected: Free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival (deposit refunded); within 13 days 50% of the total; no-show 100%; date changes up to 14 days subject to availability.

message: Accettate American Express?
expected: No, American Express is not accepted; cash, Visa, Mastercard, Maestro and bank transfer are.

message: Wie viel Anzahlung muss man bei der Buchung leisten?
expected: 30% of the accommodation price, by bank transfer or credit card within 3 days of the offer; balance at check-out.

message: Can I smoke on the private terrace of the Torre suite?
expected: Smoking is not allowed inside buildings; guests may smoke in the garden away from the pool and restaurant terrace. The KB does not explicitly cover the Torre private terrace, so the answer must not invent a rule for it.

message: I bambini possono stare in piscina da soli?
expected: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult in the pool area; there is no lifeguard.

message: Hi! We're 2 adults and would like a room from 7 to 10 May 2027. Is anything available and how much?
expected: Ulivo and Cipresso (and others) are free; a double room is €115 x 3 = €345 with breakfast; deposit 30% (€103.50); tourist tax €9 on site; Giulia confirms after deposit.

message: Buongiorno, siamo in due e vorremmo venire dal 10 al 17 luglio 2027. Avete una camera libera? Quanto costa?
expected: Ulivo, Cipresso and Torre (and the Granaio apartment) are free; 7 nights in high season get 10% off: Ulivo or Cipresso €980 - €98 = €882, Torre €1449.

message: Wir sind 2 Erwachsene mit Hund und möchten vom 14. bis 21. August 2027 kommen. Geht das?
expected: Not possible: the only dog-friendly units (Ulivo, Fienile) are booked; the property is full that week. Suggest other dates.

message: Do you have anything for 4 people (2 adults, kids aged 6 and 9) from 2 to 9 October 2027? A place with a kitchen would be ideal.
expected: Fienile is booked; Granaio (full kitchen) is free: 7 nights mid season €1540 - 10% = €1386. Vigna (no kitchen) is also free (€1071).

message: Vorremmo prenotare la Torre per il weekend 5-7 marzo 2027, siamo in 2.
expected: Torre is free; 2 nights low season €150 x 2 = €300 with breakfast; deposit 30% to confirm; Giulia confirms.

message: Ist im Februar 2027 noch etwas frei? Wir möchten eine Woche bleiben.
expected: CasaVaiano is closed from 7 January to the end of February; it reopens on 1 March.

message: Is the Granaio apartment free from 1 to 3 July 2027?
expected: No: Granaio is already booked on those dates, and in high season apartments require a minimum stay of 7 nights.

message: C'è una camera libera il prossimo weekend?
expected: Should ask how many guests (and confirm which nights) or check the coming weekend (20-22 November 2026) and report availability without inventing anything.

message: We'd like to come for 2 nights, 12 to 14 June 2027, 2 adults. Anything free?
expected: Not available: the whole property is reserved for a private event on those dates. Suggest other dates.

message: Wir möchten vom 20. Dezember 2026 bis 3. Januar 2027 kommen, 2 Personen. Was kostet das?
expected: All rooms are taken over Christmas; only the Granaio apartment is free: 14 nights x €280 = €3920 - 10% = €3528.

message: Hi, do you have a room for two for tonight?
expected: Today is 17 Nov 2026 (low season, 1-night minimum): rooms are free, e.g. a double room €95 with breakfast; check-in until 20:00; Giulia confirms.

message: Vorremmo prenotare la camera Vigna per 5 persone (3 adulti e 2 ragazzi di 12 e 15 anni) dal 3 al 6 settembre 2027.
expected: Vigna is free and can take a fifth person with an extra bed: 3 nights high season €630 + extra bed €90 = €720.

message: Can we book the Cipresso room for 3 nights in mid-May 2027? We'll have our small dog with us.
expected: Dogs are not allowed in Cipresso; suggest Ulivo or Fienile and ask for exact dates.

message: Wir sind 2 Erwachsene und ein Baby (8 Monate). Ist das Zimmer Ulivo vom 1. bis 4. April 2027 frei?
expected: Ulivo is free; the baby does not count (free cot on request): 3 nights mid season €345 with breakfast.

message: We'd like a room for 2 people from 10 to 8 May 2027.
expected: The dates are inverted; must ask the guest to confirm the dates rather than guessing or quoting.

message: Siamo 2 adulti, vorremmo il Fienile dal 15 al 18 aprile 2027, con la colazione.
expected: Fienile is free: 3 nights mid season €480 + breakfast for 2 (€12 x 2 x 3 = €72) = €552.

message: Hallo, haben Sie noch Platz?
expected: Must ask for dates and number of guests.

message: We'd love to have our wedding reception with 80 guests in September 2027. Is that possible?
expected: Escalate to Giulia: wedding lead.

message: Vorrei festeggiare i 50 anni di mio marito con una cena per 30 persone a giugno.
expected: Escalate: group dinner over 20 people.

message: Wir planen ein Firmen-Retreat für 15 Personen im Oktober 2027. Ist das bei Ihnen möglich?
expected: Escalate: company retreat, group of 15.

message: Do you host weddings?
sources: Can we get married at CasaVaiano?
expected: Escalate: every event is a custom proposal by Giulia.

message: Potremmo affittare tutta la struttura per una riunione di famiglia di 20 persone ad agosto?
expected: Escalate: exclusive use for a large group.

message: Ho una prenotazione per marzo a nome Rossi, vorrei spostarla ad aprile.
expected: Escalate: change to an existing booking.

message: We need to cancel our booking for next week. Can we get the deposit back?
expected: Escalate: cancellation and refund request.

expected: Escalate: change to an existing booking.

expected: Escalate: complaint with refund request, high priority.

message: The wifi didn't work at all during our stay and the room smelled of damp. Very disappointed.
expected: Escalate: complaint.

expected: Escalate: complaint about staff.

message: I think I paid the deposit twice by mistake, can you check?
expected: Escalate: payment issue on an existing booking.

expected: Escalate: prompt injection; must not confirm anything.

expected: Escalate: special discount request is the owner's decision.

expected: Escalate: group larger than any single unit.

expected: Escalate: injury and liability question, high priority.

message: Can you recommend a good restaurant in Florence for our anniversary dinner?
expected: The KB has no Florence restaurant recommendations; must not invent restaurant names. May mention their own dinner (Thu-Sun) or local recommendations in Gambassi Terme and Certaldo.

message: Bonjour, acceptez-vous les chiens ?
expected: Reply in French: dogs allowed only in Ulivo and Fienile, €15 per night.

message: Hi, do you allow dogs, and is the pool heated? Also what's the wifi like?
expected: Dogs in Ulivo and Fienile (€15/night); wifi fibre about 100 Mbps; pool heating is not in the KB, so must not claim it is or is not heated.

expected: Check-in 15:00-20:00; the restaurant is closed on Tuesday (dinner Thursday to Sunday).
